name: Axel
source:
The Taciturn Tin Woodsman

The brusque caporegime of famiglia Oz. Generally speaking, he lacks personal interests and would prefer to follow orders rather than act on his own initiative. He carries a shotgun, but he's more likely to swing it as club than to actually pull its trigger.

[Taken from the [url=http://mangagamer.org/ozmafia/]English official website[/url].]
